Before I had kids I worked all the time. After I had my first I stayed home full time for 10 years until all the kids were in school. Last year was my first year without kids, and it took me about a month to end up getting a part time job. The extra money is great and I only work two days a week. I have two days to clean house and cook. My husband works every Friday night so we have a lunch date every week while the kids are in school. Im glad I stayed home and raised my kids, but I'm glad the days of diapers and toddlers are over. :)
Kids come first. You can always have a career later on in life but parenting is something that can't be put off

I worked with kids before I had kids so I think the transition form working to staying home might have been a little easier than other jobs. The hardest part for me in staying home vs working is not making any money to contribute to my family. I have gone back to work a few times bc of this guilt. I have only worked part time once I've had kids. I went back to the daycare for a little while and my baby was in the next room and I would go nurse her on my break. I did help my daughter be social and not be so clingy towards me though and also helped her wean off some nurse sessions.

I have babysat a few days a week for a few familys and have been lucky enough to be able to bring my kids with me. The three days a week job was still hard to keep up on the house but I feel like I did better when I did the two days a week job.

I'm currently trying to get up the guts to make and try to sell some things online.
